title: Axolotl holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='26' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#ff5a6e'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='20' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff9aa8'/>
  <polygon points='57,42 63,42 60,46' fill='#d63a52'/>
  <path d='M60 46 Q58 54 62 62' stroke='#ffd24a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 74 Q10 70 14 82 Q18 90 30 82' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <path d='M22 74 Q14 74 16 80' stroke='#ffc2d6' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='78' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#ffd3e2'/>

  <!-- left arm reaching up to balloon string -->
  <path d='M50 62 Q56 56 62 60' stroke='#ff8fb1' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='61' r='4' fill='#ff8fb1'/>

  <!-- right arm -->
  <path d='M28 68 Q20 66 17 60' stroke='#ff8fb1' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='59' r='4' fill='#ff8fb1'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M32 86 L30 92' stroke='#ff8fb1' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 86 L54 92' stroke='#ff8fb1' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='42' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#ff8fb1'/>

  <!-- gills left -->
  <path d='M20 34 Q10 28 10 22' stroke='#ff5f8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M18 42 Q8 40 6 34' stroke='#ff5f8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 50 Q10 52 8 58' stroke='#ff5f8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- gills right -->
  <path d='M60 34 Q70 28 70 22' stroke='#ff5f8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 42 Q72 40 74 34' stroke='#ff5f8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 50 Q70 52 72 58' stroke='#ff5f8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ff5f8a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ff5f8a'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#3a1030'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#3a1030'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M35 50 Q40 55 45 50' stroke='#a3325a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
